Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys shoot. Mixing a movement key with a fire arrow moves+shoots simultaneously. Diagonal moves stall on rocks whose hitboxes exceed sprites — reposition lanes instead of pushing. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse); it damages self; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Q/Space do nothing.

TECH X: CONFIRMED this run — the pill pedestal in the two-poop room granted Tech X ('Laser ring tears') on entry, matching earlier runs. It is re-obtainable there. An eyeball/laser visual attaches to the character when held. Do not assume it is present every run (one earlier run had no pedestal and plain tears), so verify on entry.

LASERS: when held, firing makes a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, NOT a lock marker or telegraph (uncertain). Lasers kill white-faced chasers safely at range only when aimed down the correct row/column. CONFIRMED: lasers do NOT destroy rocks — firing up the torch-room chest column left the ring rocks intact. A two-poop-room center rock had earlier vanished between visits; cause unknown, NOT attributable to lasers (guess: separate event/room variant).

KEYS: key counter read 01 for most of the latest run (earlier runs showed 00 with no visible pickup, and 01 without a visible pickup). KEYHOLE DOOR TESTED AND FAILED: with key 01, standing adjacent to the rock-field left-wall keyhole door (~x0.19-0.20, y~0.46), pressing into it, aligning vertically, and firing left at it did NOT open it and did NOT consume the key. Whether some other action opens it (or whether it needs a different key/condition) is UNRESOLVED. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers are still suspected key-locked (guess).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor (confirmed again). Torch-room center gray chest is sealed by indestructible rocks — now tested from left (approach via x~0.39 row through the poop gap blocked), top, and right earlier; ABANDON definitively. The dark chest room's two red-lidded UNspiked chests (upper-left ~(0.33,0.33), upper-right ~(0.67,0.33)) do NOT open on contact; approaching the upper-left one cost a heart (likely a chaser). Central spiked chest there is untouchable. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing — never bomb at low health or adjacent to self. Rocks judged indestructible.

BOMB-WALKER ENEMY (TNT room): a bomb-holding walking enemy at mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction even when nearly column-aligned; shots often drifted off-column. Unclear whether it is armored, has an offset hitbox, or tears simply miss; horizontal shots untested. Treat as dangerous; keep distance.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms) and can expand into large area bursts — a large blob with a spiky rock aura was seen. Green glowing thing near the TNT bottom hatch behaved like a fly/creature, not a collectible — treat as hazard (fairly confident). Rock field is a severe heart drainer; white-faced chasers pursue fast and cluster near hatches and doors; also seen there: small spiky pellets (guess: turret bottom-right), spiked-wheel wall decor, blue-tear shooters, spiked-ring enemy, gray round enemy near top hatch, and a spiky black rock ring with a gray enemy inside at room center. Corner torches damage on touch. Dark chest room: small black creatures/chasers plus black blob/pit shapes at y~0.48; damage cascades there. Standing adjacent to containers while creatures roam is unsafe. HEART DROPS: hearts were seen refilling from 1 to 2 mid-fight in the latest run (partial heal observed; hearts can apparently be regained in combat — mechanism uncertain, possibly dropped pickups being collected).

DEATH LESSONS: entering enemy rooms without first thinning enemies from the doorway is fatal; at 1 or half a heart any contact ends the run — flee to a hatch rather than fight. Chasers can materialize adjacent (winged forms) and damage lands faster than warps can be set up; do not loiter in the rock field aligning hatches with enemies alive nearby.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warp needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks warp — back off ~0.15 and re-center, then hold; multiple attempts are normal. On failure back off/re-center rather than pressing harder. One long sustained walk (1.0s) from ~0.2 below worked after shorter holds failed.

MAP / ROUTES (all hatches confirmed working):
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49-0.50 <-> torch room; right doorway y~0.47 <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch ~(0.51,0.80) <-> tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48 (does not open with key 01 contact/shots).
- Torch room: top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.16-0.18 <-> tutorial bottom hatch (bidirectional, entered from tutorial spawning just below it); gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76-0.79 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable full height (used to route around the center rock cluster up to the top hatch). Center column blocked by rocks below the chest ring.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17 (approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks). Poop piles regenerate and drop nothing; center rock gone in latest visit.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring on right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue cre
